name: The Montagu Arms

layers.essential_history: [[c:The Montagu Arms began as three or four cottages in the early 1600s. It is named after the Montagu family, who were granted the manor of Barnwell by Henry VIII in 1540.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Barnwell Brook runs through the village on its way to the River Nene, which separates Barnwell from Oundle.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Parson Latham is pacing outside: the key to the almshouse chest is gone. A boy hands you a note he found by the door.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The note by the door]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Each letter has been moved one place along the alphabet. Move each one back a place.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where is the chest kept? (one word)]]
hints: [[c:The ruin at the north of the village.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It says CASTLE. The chest is in the old castle.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The almshouse money chest is kept in the castle.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: the Montagu Arms is the village pub.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:From the Montagu Arms, cross the brook and walk along to the almshouses, about 150 metres.]]
